t: 法兰西国王罗伯特一世被击毙,国王"简易"(Charles the Simple)被勃艮第公爵鲁…
te: King Robert I of France is killed and King Charles the Simple is arrested by the supporters of Duke Rudolph of Burgundy.
dz: 索伊松之战:法兰西国王罗伯特一世被击毙,国王"简易"(Charles the Simple)被勃艮第公爵鲁道夫的支持者逮捕.
de: Battle of Soissons: King Robert I of France is killed and King Charles the Simple is arrested by the supporters of Duke Rudolph of Burgundy.

t: 活佛恩祖奥拉战役(Battle of Firenzuola):由鲁道夫二世国王和阿达尔伯特一世…
te: Lombard forces under King Rudolph II and Adalbert I, margrave of Ivrea, defeat the dethroned Emperor Berengar I of Ital…
dz: 活佛恩祖奥拉战役(Battle of Firenzuola):由鲁道夫二世国王和阿达尔伯特一世所领导的伦巴德部队,被伊夫雷亚的马尔格雷夫击败被废黜的意大利皇帝贝伦加尔一世于活佛恩祖奥拉(图斯卡尼).
de: Battle of Firenzuola: Lombard forces under King Rudolph II and Adalbert I, margrave of Ivrea, defeat the dethroned Emperor Berengar I of Italy at Firenzuola (Tuscany).

t: 巴哈伦的卡尔马提人夺取并掠夺了巴士拉市.
te: The Qarmatians of Bahrayn capture and pillage the city of Basra.
dz: 巴哈伦的卡尔马提人夺取并掠夺了巴士拉市.
de: The Qarmatians of Bahrayn capture and pillage the city of Basra.
